newsitem.title: INDIA: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA WIN TOSS AND OPT TO FIELD.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA WIN TOSS AND OPT TO FIELD.

text.p: Australian captain Mark
Taylor won the toss and put India in to bat first in the last
league match of the Titan Cup triangular limited-over series on
Sunday.
Australia made three changes to the side that lost to South
Africa at Guwahati on Friday. Wicket-keeper Ian Healy, Mark
Waugh and Jason Gillespie came in for Adam Gilchrist, Ricky
Ponting and Damien Fleming.
India left out off-spinner Aashish Kapoor to bring in
all-rounder Robin Singh, whose last international appearance was
in 1989 in the West Indies.
The Trinidad-born Singh, 31, took the place of injured
left-handed batsman Saurav Ganguly in the 14-member Indian
squad.
Teams:
Australia: Mark Taylor (captain), Michael Slater, Mark
Waugh, Steve Waugh, Stuart Law, Michael Bevan, Ian Healy, Brad
Hogg, Jason Gillespie, Paul Reiffel, Glenn McGrath.
India: Sachin Tendulkar (captain), Navjot Sidhu, Rahul
Dravid, Mohammed Azharuddin, Ajay Jadeja, Robin Singh, Sunil
Joshi, Nayan Mongia, Javagal Srinath, Anil Kumble,Venkatesh
Prasad.
Umpires: S.K.Sharma and A.V.Jayaprakash (both India). Third
umpire: Jasir Singh (India).
Match referee: John Reid (New Zealand).
